The series matrix has zero feature rows. ENA lists 79 single-end runs across the 36 experiments. Methods and Fig. 5E describe male C57BL/6J mice after ten weeks of feeding, with three SCN replicates per diet at each of ZT0, 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20. The registered DE table has 14,644 distinct symbols and SHA-256 60a7666c1ec77413637842c3d7040c3c9824ec560e63a3db0c18e5fcce7d4172. Summing duplicate FPKMs before the registered filter (>0.5 in at least 12 libraries) recovered the entire tested set. The balanced-design HFD-minus-chow differences on log2(FPKM + 1) reproduced every fitted coefficient to within 6.0e-15. BH adjustment of the registered P values agreed to within 5.6e-16. Each of S5 and S6 has 24,346 rows, six ID/rhythm fields and 18 replicate columns. At the authors' Fig. 5 cutoff of JTK P < 0.05, the workbook IDs reproduce 1,635 chow-only, 220 shared and 961 HFD-only oscillators. S1–S4 analyze metabolites, S7 reports KEGG enrichment, and Fig. S7 reports mPFC qPCR. BioStudies lists all eight supplements. An additional OmicsDI accession search returned only GSE157077 and PRJNA660021. The later cilia study reports periodicity in a gene subset. Across the reviewed sources, zero author effects could be paired with the registered diet coefficient. No v2 threshold or subset was used to claim concordance. All six proposed enum values occur in their respective ledger fields. Only the manual and verification ledgers currently contain this dataset.
problems: The S5/S6 row counts and headers are correct, but they conceal an identifier and aggregation difference. In each workbook 27 ID cells are Excel dates and 24,319 contain distinct text labels. For all 280 repeated GEO labels, the workbook's expression vector matches an individual deposited row. It differs from the registered linear sum for 176 labels in chow and 177 in HFD.

The proposal lists lag and amplitude without quantifying missing results. All 24,346 rows per workbook have numeric period, P and Q. Numeric lag is available for 9,534 chow and 8,410 HFD rows, and amplitude for 20,682 and 20,641 respectively. The other entries in those fields are marked NA.

The manual note omits the ZT-specific between-diet CyberT tests in S3/S4 when summarizing the remaining supplements. These tests measure metabolites. The corrected note also retains the prior exploratory qualifier and identifies the registered provenance pins as the basis of the input checksum claim.
